title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Selective Margin Preservation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At s

translated_title: 超越分布匹配：面向监督微调的选择性边际保持方法
translated_abstract: 监督微调（SFT）会在教师强制前缀下改变非目标token之间的logit边际。匹配局部参考分布能够保持这些概率，但同时也会惩罚边际的扩大。我们探究的问题是：一个软辅助目标能否在不冻结该参考分布的前提下，保持选定的局部非目标边际关系。我们提出了选择性秩保持SFT（SRP-SFT），这是一种软边际目标：对来自参考分布top-K非目标token的token对，施加基于参考分布缩放下界的铰链惩罚，并应用于固定的教师强制前缀。一旦所要求的下界得到满足，铰链惩罚即停止。我们推导了违反边际所带来的KL代价，刻画了可行区域及其条件效用，并给出了降低总体边际违反的有限步条件。在Qwen3-4B-Base模型和UltraFeedback数据集上的单轮训练实验中，该目标在全部三个训练随机种子上均使MATH-500和代码生成得分超过交叉熵（CE）和LP-SFT方法。
tldr: 提出SRP-SFT，一种通过铰链惩罚选择性保持非目标token边际关系的软边际目标，在不冻结参考分布的情况下显著提升了监督微调的数学推理与代码生成性能。
en_tdlr: SRP-SFT is introduced, a soft margin objective using hinge penalties to selectively preserve non-target margin relations without freezing the reference distribution, improving math reasoning and code generation performance in supervised fine-tuning.
